text: In July 2021, Apex Group Ltd. said that Carlyle and the sovereign investor Mubadala Investment Company had taken minority stakes in the business, investing alongside founder Peter Hughes, majority owner Genstar Capital and TA Associates. Genstar Capital said in June 2021 that Apex was majority-owned by it.
short: In 2021 Genstar Capital was Apex Group's majority owner; Mubadala took a minority stake.

source.name: Apex Group: Apex Group secures additional equity investment from Carlyle and Mubadala
source.quote: We are proud to now have the equity backing of three highly reputable institutions, including our majority owner Genstar, and now joined by Mubadala.

additionalSources.name: Genstar Capital: TA Associates Announces Strategic Growth Investment in Apex Group in Partnership with Genstar Capital and Peter Hughes
additionalSources.quote: Apex is majority-owned by Genstar Capital
